svg.title: The units of the Core Collection as strips on a desk
svg.desc: The Core Collection: vNorm Shrink, vTanh Squash, vLookback, vRunning Average, vQuantise, vRotate, vPrincipal Bands, vPosition Repeat, vSparsify, vComponent Clamp, vBand Shrink, vMorph, vAbliterate, vNeuron, vEntropy, vPeak share, in the collection's look, at the settings of their example lines, each with what it needs from a host. Generated from the units' manifests by tools/build_site.py.
